title: A species' Pokédex data: res/pokemon/<species>/pokedex.json
description: What the Pokédex's search and area map know of a species, which tools/data/pokedex_data.py packs into ARCID_POKEDEX_DATA's files 0 to 2 (a/0/9/7) and ARCID_POKEDEX_AREA (a/1/7/6), in the order of generated/species.txt. The species from SPECIES_NONE to SPECIES_EGG have one, and those after them have none: they have no shape and live nowhere.

initial.description: The letter the species' name starts with, which the search's initials pick from (ARCID_POKEDEX_DATA's file 1, PokedexSearchEngine's initials: 0 for A to 25 for Z, 26 for none); null for none. Every species before the last with one has one: SPECIES_NONE to SPECIES_GENESECT

shapes.description: The body shape of the species and then of each of its other forms, in form order: the search's shape icon, 0 to 13 (POKEDEX_SEARCH_SHAPE_COUNT; PokedexSearchEngine_GetShape). ARCID_POKEDEX_DATA's file 2 has the species' shapes in species order, then every other form's, and file 0 links a species to its forms and each form to the next, which the search and pokedex_info.c's next form follow, so the count of shapes is the count of forms that the Pokédex knows

area.description: Where the species lives, on the area map (PokedexHabitat in pokedex_detail_map.c, ARCID_POKEDEX_AREA's file of species - 1). Without one it lives nowhere

anyOf.description: The area for Black 2 and for White 2, where they differ

all_year.description: Whether the species lives in the same places all year (allYear), so the map shows no season; then it has places, else seasons

places.description: The town map's places where the species lives, each by its zone (sPokedexDetailMapZones in pokedex_detail_map.c, which gives the places' order), with the kinds of habitat it has there: the encounter groups, which the map draws as land (HABITAT_LAND: grass, dark_grass, shaking_grass), water (HABITAT_WATER: surf, rippling_surf) and fishing (HABITAT_FISHING: fishing, rippling_fishing). No places is nowhere

seasons.description: The places of each season, which the map shows for the game's season
